review_highlights.title: Terrible experiance
review_highlights.snippet: I had breakfast at this place with my family, and unfortunately the experience was extremely disappointing. The waiters did not come to take our order at all—I had to go and ask one of them to come to our table. When the food finally arrived, it was cold. I ordered cake because my 5-year-old son asked for it. Since I was traveling to Cairo in 10 minutes, I asked for the order to be takeaway. While we were already eating, a waiter suddenly came and told us we were not allowed to eat inside because the order was marked as takeaway. I explained clearly that I was traveling in 10 minutes and that this was the reason for the takeaway request, but he insisted. He then brought his manager, a lady, who repeated the same statement without any attempt to understand or accommodate the situation—even after I told her I was visiting Alexandria and leaving immediately. This was the lowest level of service I have ever received in any restaurant anywhere in the world. I do not recommend this place at all. review_highlights.title: Great experience
review_highlights.snippet: Great experience staff is friendly Food was great Sunshine was amazing recently visited this waffle shop and was pleasantly impressed! The waffles are light, fluffy, and perfectly golden with just the right amount of crispiness on the outside. Each bite melts in your mouth, and the toppings are fresh, generous, and beautifully balanced—not overly sweet but truly satisfying. The variety on the menu makes it easy to find something for every mood, whether you’re craving chocolate, fruit, or something savory. The presentation is also fantastic, making each dish feel special. On top of that, the shop has a cozy, welcoming atmosphere with friendly staff who clearly care about quality and service. It’s the perfect spot for breakfast, dessert, or even a quick treat. Highly recommended for waffle lovers!
